state_vocabulary.LIVE: the full intended binding is real AND proven by authenticated end-to-end runtime
state_vocabulary.PARTIAL: some binding links are real; the exact remaining gaps are named
state_vocabulary.READ_ONLY_CONTEXT: Paige can safely understand this surface but cannot act on it
state_vocabulary.INTENTIONALLY_ISOLATED: sensitive data on this surface must not enter Paige/Mind/Memory
state_vocabulary.UNAVAILABLE: the required Paige-binding contract does not exist yet
state_vocabulary.PROOF_OWED: the binding is implemented and reachable in code, but authenticated/runtime proof is absent

intended_capability_note: Every surface carries BOTH `state` (what is PROVEN today — the current-state vocabulary) AND `intended_capability` (the product operating TARGET across authority lanes). An absent current proof NEVER shrinks the intended target; the ledger describes the gap between present proof and the full operating goal. Paige is built to help RUN the company through real governed actions, not to report passively.

authority_lanes.read: What Paige may safely read and understand (enumerated safe facts; never raw payload or secrets).
authority_lanes.draft: What Paige may draft, model, organize, prepare, or recommend — a proposal or artifact with NO side effect.
authority_lanes.auto: What Paige may EXECUTE autonomously within a tenant-approved policy (§16 green AI-Performed / §67 per-process grant).
authority_lanes.confirm: What requires OWNER CONFIRMATION before execution (§16 yellow AI-Drafted/Human-Approved, via the paige_pending_confirmations gate).
authority_lanes.prohibited: What is permanently ISOLATED or prohibited — raw secrets, credentials, unreviewed sensitive files, authority escalation (§16 red / §67/§68).
authority_lanes.completion_criterion: The REAL action/outcome that proves the surface is complete — not that Paige can merely open or summarize it.

release_contract.rule: A surface may not be reported LIVE, or 'Paige-connected', without a complete entry here whose state is LIVE and whose evidence_class includes 'authenticated_runtime'. A rendered page, a green badge, a local UI control, a prototype, or an 'Open Paige' button never satisfies a binding link.

honest_platform_position: As of the grounding SHA, NO surface is LIVE. Mind axis-B (authenticated tenant-safe evidence flowing for a real owner) is NO for every surface (docs/architecture/paige-mind-integration-matrix.md). The read-context capabilities are chat-injected and unit-tested but unproven at runtime (PROOF_OWED); the governed writes are wired but unproven and mostly Mind/Rail-incomplete (PARTIAL); everything else is UNAVAILABLE, sourceless, isolated, or awaiting a Spine Change Request.

intended_capability.read: The safe surface context handed to the workspace — surface id, public-safe record ref, readiness/provenance — never raw payload or authority.
intended_capability.draft: Compose replies, proposals, and the intended question/plan for the surface the owner opened from.
intended_capability.auto: Within the tenant's policy, run read-only tool calls and ordinary governed actions the process grant permits.
intended_capability.confirm: Any high-risk or owner_only action raises an approval card (paige_pending_confirmations) before execution.
intended_capability.prohibited: Never accept a client-supplied tenant, role, raw prose, or secret as authority or identity (the #981 leak class).
intended_capability.completion_criterion: An owner opens Paige from a surface and Paige acts on that surface's real record through a governed tool, with the outcome recorded — never a blind chat window.
